0022600164.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-6, 0-4 on the road, on a six-game losing streak and 15th in the West) visit the Dallas Mavericks (4-2, winners of three straight, 2-1 at home and 7th in the West) for the Kings' seventh game of the season. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), Keegan Murray (ankle, averaging 7.0 points and 27.2 minutes this season), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while Zach LaVine (elbow, soreness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision after averaging 23.5 points and 34.0 minutes. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation), with Kyrie Irving (knee) day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Kings won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 130-121 win in Dallas on February 26, 2026.
